mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation_cancel (cancel_reasons, cancel_status, cancel_date, reservation_no) VALUES ( #{cancelReasons}, #{cancelStatus}, current_timestamp(), #{reservationNo} )
mapper.select: SELECT rc.cancel_no as cancelNo, rc.cancel_reasons as cancelReasons, rc.cancel_status as cancelStatus, STR_TO_DATE(rc.cancel_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as cancelDate, STR_TO_DATE(rc.cancel_resp_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as cancelRespDate, rc.reservation_no as reservationNo FROM reservation_cancel rc WHERE rc.reservation_no = #{reservationNo}
